rivals.reason: The 2016 Ford Mustang GT offers a muscular V8 engine and a distinctive exhaust note that makes it a direct competitor to the Challenger R/T.
The 2016 Chevy Camaro SS features a powerful V8 and a throaty sound that rivals the Challenger's performance and auditory appeal.
The 2016 Nissan 370Z Nismo delivers sporty performance and a unique rasp that appeals to enthusiasts looking for an alternative to American muscle.
The 2016 Chrysler 300 SRT8 combines luxury with a HEMI V8 engine, offering a refined yet aggressive sound that makes it a notable competitor.
